hook.say: Five European countries, five outlines. You get 3 seconds each, and the last one is the hardest!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.fact: France: its mainland is nicknamed the Hexagon for its six-sided shape.
questions.sayAnswer: France! Its mainland is nicknamed the Hexagon, because of its six-sided shape.

questions.fact: Spain: home to the Sagrada Família, under construction since 1882.
questions.sayAnswer: Spain! Home to the Sagrada Familia, under construction since 1882.

questions.fact: United Kingdom: England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland in one country.
questions.sayAnswer: The United Kingdom! England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland, all in one country.

questions.fact: Germany is the most populous country in the European Union.
questions.sayAnswer: Germany! It is the most populous country in the European Union.

questions.fact: Poland: its capital Warsaw lies on the Vistula, the country's longest river.
questions.sayAnswer: Poland! Its capital, Warsaw, lies on the Vistula, the longest river in the country.
